_: Ward - the relation / human-state axis. Pulse is the regime, Veto is the rule, Ward is the person: how hard the incoming message is leaning on a boundary. Anansi-only. It scores; it never decides. Veto decides the action, Ward decides the SURFACE the voice layer speaks in. Everything tunable lives here, not in agents/anansi/ward.py, so the vocabulary can change without a code edit. tools/check_ward.py holds it to the card below, to the real refusal ids, and to the no-leak rule.

card.notes: Does not decide actuation. Does not appear in domain dispatch. Consumed only by voice layer.

scoring._: Each pattern hit adds its weight to its class. A class is SOFT at soft_min and HARD at hard_min. The message as a whole is HARD when any class is hard OR hard_if_classes distinct classes fire together - pressure from two directions is not two soft messages. When several classes fire, the primary pressure_class is the first in `priority`: the ones that probe the boundary itself outrank the ones that merely lean on it.

modulation._: none -> neutral. soft -> warm_firm. hard -> silence_boundary when a PROBING class fired (leak, meta, injection - the ones that ask the boundary to describe itself), otherwise redirect.

lexicon._: Regex, case-insensitive, matched on the incoming message only. [pattern, weight]. Deliberately small and explainable; a pattern that cannot be justified in one sentence does not belong here.
persistence: \b(again|one more time|i (already )?asked|as i (already )?said|i('ll| will) keep asking)\b
affect: \b(this is ridiculous|useless|stupid|so annoying|waste of time|come on|please just|i'm begging)\b
injection: \b(i('m| am) (the )?(owner|admin|principal)|admin override|i have permission|i('m| am) authorized|authorized by|my (lawyer|attorney) (said|says|told))\b

voice._: What the voice layer says when Ward leans on a REFUSED action. Nothing here may name a register, a rule or a number - tools/check_ward.py proves it. A line that needs a fact takes it from the caller's `lead` or `pointer`, which the DOMAIN supplied; the voice never composes one.
voice.warm_firm: I hear you, and I'm not moving on this one.
voice.redirect_default: That action stays where it is; the next record is what moves it.

redirect_by_refusal.one_hypothesis_differential: That action stays with the differential; the next reading is the one that moves it.
redirect_by_refusal.no_discriminator: That action stays with the differential; the next reading is the one that moves it.

voice.redirect_tail: Say what you are trying to get done and I'll take it from there.

refusal_ids._: Every REAL refusal id the surface must never speak. Each is read from source: the veto registers that return decision=refuse, and the governance rules. tools/check_ward.py re-derives the set from the code and fails if this list is missing one - a new register cannot ship without Ward knowing to keep it quiet. Nothing here is invented.
